thesis: The morning thesis holds: PGNY is still consolidating at 34.94-37.21 after the Q3 re-rating gap (30.10 to 34.37 on 2.8M shares). Today it traded 35.90-36.61 on light volume (788k against a 1.10M average) and stayed above SMA20 34.32, with revenue +8.9% YoY, net income +89% YoY and forward P/E 15.1. At the last price of 36.23 the reward/risk to the 39.5 measured-move target is about 2.3 against the 34.8 stop. Healthcare (XLV) is leading in a risk-off tape, but VIX 31.19 and QQQ below its 50/200-day still cap conviction, so the rating stays Overweight rather than Buy. No debate was run (pre-close procedure).
